properties.name: survival_requires_performance
properties.statement: At Adarlan's court, survival depends on managing appearances as carefully as violence.
properties.rationale: Celaena's status only stabilizes when she turns wit, discipline, and symbolic acts into strategic performance.

properties.name: trust_follows_protection
properties.statement: Trust in this story is earned through repeated acts of protection, not through titles or promises.
properties.rationale: Chaol and Nehemia become meaningful to Celaena only after their care is demonstrated under risk.

properties.name: suppressed_magic_resurfaces_through_proxies
properties.statement: Suppressed magic does not disappear; it resurfaces indirectly through symbols, agents, and corrupted institutions.
properties.rationale: The clock tower, Wyrdmarks, Elena's warnings, and Cain's transformation all show hidden power leaking back through proxies.
